text_block_list.text:
After training, at the strong insistence 
of Winning Ticket with Biwa Hayahide in 
tow, we came to a family restaurant near 
the academy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Mmm! So gewd~~!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Huge portions! Juicy hamburg steaks! I've 
been dying to sink my teeth into these~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
After giving it your all in training, 
you've gotta give it your all at mealtime 
too, right~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... Eat a little slower. It won't be 
funny if you end up choking on your food.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In addition, be careful not to overeat. 
Gaining weight will affect your races.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm... but still... I wanna eat a whole 
lot more~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Appropriate amount... Appropriate amount, 
huh~? Umm, just how much is an appropriate 
amount?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... It varies a bit depending on 
what it is, but with meals, the benchmark 
is just before feeling completely full.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I see...! Which means—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Empty belly and stuffed belly! 
Half-and-half makes it a half-stuffed 
belly! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'll do my absolute best to stick 
to the right portion~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Your sense of taste really is 
quite unique, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! I knew it! That's our 
Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Eating with all your might until your 
belly's completely stuffed puts the 
biggest smile on your face~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. If such freedom is your 
guiding policy, then I shall refrain from 
meddling.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket. It appears your Trainer possesses 
a remarkably broad capacity.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm? Isn't the rice bowl you use, Trainer, 
about average-sized?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm not talking about the 
tableware, though.
